preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10,000.
The length of the array B for each test case must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(-1 <= B[i] <= 10**5 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each element in the array B must be between -1 and 100,000.
The total number of elements across all test cases must not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or all(0 <= A[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(N))
postconditions.description: If no valid array A exists, output -1; otherwise, all elements of A must be between 0 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.expression: all(mex(A[:i+1]) == B[i] for i in range(N) if B[i] >= 0)
postconditions.description: For each index i where B[i] is non-negative, the mex of the first i+1 elements of A must equal B[i].
